name: hexana-core
description: Inspect WebAssembly modules with Hexana MCP tools from Claude Desktop.
long_description: Hexana Core packages the standalone Hexana MCP server for local Claude Desktop use. It analyzes WebAssembly binaries from directories selected during installation.

tools.name: summarize_binary
tools.description: Summarize a Wasm or native binary with compact identity and entity counts.

tools.name: summarize_module
tools.description: Summarize a WebAssembly module — counts of imports, exports, memories, globals, functions, types.

tools.name: list_enabled_features
tools.description: List enabled or inferred WebAssembly feature flags for a `.wasm` module.

tools.name: get_entrypoint_policy
tools.description: Return policy-ready direct host-call facts for exported WebAssembly entrypoints.

tools.name: list_required_proposals
tools.description: List required WebAssembly proposals inferred from detected module features.

tools.name: diff_required_proposals
tools.description: Diff required WebAssembly proposals between a current and baseline module.

tools.name: check_runtime_compatibility
tools.description: Check a WebAssembly module's required proposals against a conservative runtime support profile.

tools.name: check_component_compatibility
tools.description: Compare current/previous component imports against provider candidates and lock/config files.

tools.name: plan_abi_binding_regeneration
tools.description: Plan report-ready ABI binding regeneration from current Wasm plus a stale binding file.

tools.name: check_memory_contract
tools.description: Check a memory contract with current/baseline Wasm and policy JSON; returns report-ready violations.

tools.name: audit_global_state_policy
tools.description: Audit global-state policy with current/baseline Wasm and policy JSON; returns report-ready violations.

tools.name: audit_local_stack_budget
tools.description: Audit exported function local counts against a local stack budget policy.

tools.name: list_imports
tools.description: List imported functions declared by a `.wasm` module.

tools.name: list_exports
tools.description: List exports declared by a `.wasm` module.

tools.name: search_exports
tools.description: Search exports by name and resolve common export metadata.

tools.name: list_exported_functions
tools.description: List exported functions within a closed range of the export section.

tools.name: list_functions
tools.description: List imported and defined functions with offset/limit pagination.

tools.name: resolve_function_signature
tools.description: Resolve the type index and signature for one function index.

tools.name: disassemble_function
tools.description: Disassemble one function by unified function index.

tools.name: get_function_call_graph
tools.description: Return resolved direct calls and memory write sites for function indices.

tools.name: search_functions_by_name
tools.description: Search function names across imports, exports, and debug names.

tools.name: resolve_wasm_frames
tools.description: Aggregate WebAssembly crash-report and stack-frame triage from function indices, labels, and offsets.

tools.name: resolve_function_symbols
tools.description: Focused lookup for function indices, symbols, signatures, and metadata.

tools.name: resolve_source_locations
tools.description: Focused source lookup for WebAssembly code offsets or function indices.

tools.name: list_memory
tools.description: Low-level list of imported and defined memories from a `.wasm` module.

tools.name: list_globals
tools.description: Low-level list of imported and defined globals from a `.wasm` module.

tools.name: list_element_segments
tools.description: List element segments declared by a `.wasm` module.

tools.name: list_data_segments
tools.description: Return data-segment metadata with range slicing and optional export/global context.

tools.name: audit_data_payload_policy
tools.description: Audit data segments against a payload policy JSON file and return report-ready matches.

allowed_directories.title: Allowed Directories
allowed_directories.description: Directories containing WebAssembly files that Hexana may read.
